Not tomorrow’s leaders. Today’s examples.

A paragon is one who represents the very best: an ideal, a model, a standard. That is who we are raising, because Scripture never told youth to wait.

The Paragons is the Graduate Fellowship of the Enthronement House Christian Centre, a vibrant arm of the Enthronement Assembly, established by our Spiritual Parents, Rev. Deji Olabode and Dr. Seun Olabode, under the directorate of Special Duties. Our mission is whole-person growth through eight pillars, each grounded in the Bible and modeled on Christ, our ultimate Paragon.

8Core pillarsTraining, mentorship, networking and more, each rooted in Scripture.
3Spheres of influenceFaith, career and culture.
1Ultimate ParagonJesus Christ, our model and our standard.

“Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.”

1 Timothy 4:12 (NKJV)

The colors we wear.

Every shade you see on this page has a story. Tap a color to find out what it means to us.

Royalty, with a quiet kind of power.

  • RoyalPurple has always been the color of kings.
  • Close to GodIt hints at mystery, closeness and His presence.
  • WiseFaith that thinks deeply and keeps growing up.

Fun fact: Jesus was robed in purple. Mark 15:17

The color of our energy.

  • CreativeYoung, bold and full of fresh ideas.
  • AwakeThink change, fire and a spiritual wake-up call.
  • Kingdom kidRoyal identity with a modern twist.

You’ll spot it all over our youth and creative teams.

A fresh start, every single time.

  • PureLiving clean and set apart for God.
  • ClearGod’s truth, easy to see.
  • PeacefulCalm that brings everyone together.

“Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.” Isaiah 1:18

A little goes a long way.

  • StrongWe take who we are seriously.
  • In aweDeep respect for how great God is.
  • Makes things popIt lets every other color shine.

We use it sparingly, so it hits just right.
